Special Branch S"2". □□□□□□
REPORT
Date July 2nd. 1935.

Subject Joe LANZET, Panamanian- Enquiry from the Netherlands Consulat

Made by D.S.Lingard. Forwarded by □□□□□□□□□□ □□

With reference to the Confidential enquiry from the
Netherlands Consulate-General regarding a Panamanian named
Joe LANZET, residing at 45 North Haining Road, I have to
report that there is nothing in Municipal Police records
to the detriment of this person.
Joe LANZET came to Shanghai during August 1928, and since
October 22 1928 he has been living at No.45 North Haining Rd.
which latter address is a boarding house registered in the
name of a Miss B. Yavorskaya who is known to be LANZET's
paramour.
That Joe LANZET formerly operated a hairdressing establishment
on Yu Yuen Road is correct, but this place was never the
subject of any unfavourable report.
                                                D.S. Lingard
                                                D. S.
Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch).

Mr Yas,
Please prepare reply.
J.P.G.

报告
日期：1935年7月2日。

事由：乔·兰泽特（Joe LANZET），巴拿马籍——荷兰领事馆的查询

由 D.S. Lingard 制作。转呈者 □□□□□□□□□□ □□

关于荷兰总领事馆就居住在海宁北路45号的巴拿马人乔·兰泽特（Joe LANZET）提出的机密查询，本人谨报告称，工部局警务处档案中并无不利于此人的记录。
乔·兰泽特于1928年8月抵达上海，自1928年10月22日起一直居住在海宁北路45号，该地址是一处以 B. Yavorskaya 小姐名义注册的寄宿公寓，众所周知她是兰泽特的情妇。
乔·兰泽特此前曾在愚园路经营一家理发店一事属实，但该场所从未受到任何不利报告的影响。
                                                D.S. Lingard
                                                D. S.
副总监（特务科）。

Yas 先生，
请准备回复。
J.P.G.

I beg to report having interviewed the
Municipal Advocate with reference to your query.
The Municipal Advocate has no further comment

the matter as the Supreme Court holds that there
can be no appeal in extradition cases.

My name is Zee Kwen Sung, aged 25, native of Wusih,
residing at No.7 Yee Ching Lee(頤子里), Fang Pang Road

know why my fellow workers were arrested. I have never been
arrested for Communism neither have I ever been concerned in
such activities. I admit I attended a meeting of workers of

the Union.

中央捕房        1935年10月22日，      书记员 方国良

本人名为陆善本，现年27岁，籍贯浦东，排字工人，居住在汉口路274号《新闻报》宿舍。
本人曾于1月6日因涉嫌共产主义被中国当局逮捕。随后本人悔过，并于1月18日获释。被捕时本人受雇于《新闻报》，获释后返回工作岗位并复职。本人一直连续工作至10月22日下午6时再次被捕。自从向中国当局悔过后，本人未参与任何共产主义活动，因此对被捕原因感到困惑。
本人参加了1935年10月20日下午6时在《新闻报》大楼举行的《新闻报》工人会议。本人是报业工会的普通会员，在工会中不担任领导职务。

Date October 21, 1935.
Subject Newspaper Office Workers' Union - reorganization ordered by
local Tangpu.
Made by D.I. Sih Tse Liang Forwarded by
On October 17, the local Tangpu issued an order to the
Newspaper Office Workers' Union instructing that the Union be
reorganized. Subsequently fifteen members of the Union were
appointed by the local Tangpu to serve on a reorganization
committee, and one named Sui Ziang-yung (水祥雲 ), a
committee member of the General Labour Union, was appointed
as advisor to the committee.
The reorganization is opposed by the members of the
Union, who are mostly workers of the Sin Wan Pao. In connection
with this matter some 300 workers of this newspaper held a
meeting at 6.30 p.m. October 20, on the 2nd floor of the Sin
Wan Pao building, 274 Hankow Road. Liu Tsz-chien (劉子金 ),
a type-setter, stated that the decision of the local Tangpu
to reorganize the Newspaper Workers' Union was instigated by
an ex-member of the Union named Loh Tung-sung (陸東生 ) who had
been expelled from membership for attempted extortion. He
asked the meeting to decide whether the order of the Tangpu
for the reorganization of the Union should be accepted or not.
After some discussion, the following resolutions were passed :-
1) That the order for the reorganization be accepted but the
original title of the Union, namely, the Newspaper Office
Workers' Union (報館工會 ), be preserved. (According
to the order of the local Tangpu, the title of the Union is
to be changed to "Newspaper Trade Workers' Union" (報販業
工會).
2) That any person who is not a member of the Newspaper Office
Workers' Union be not allowed to participate in its
activities or to interfere in the administration of the
Union.

日期：1935年10月21日。
事由：报业职工工会——当地党部下令改组。
由 督察 Sih Tse Liang 制作 转呈者
10月17日，当地党部向报业职工工会发布命令，指示对该工会进行改组。随后，当地党部任命了十五名工会成员组成改组委员会，并任命一名名为水祥雲 (Sui Ziang-yung) 的人为委员会顾问，此人是总工会的委员。
工会成员反对此次改组，他们大多是《新闻报》的工人。与此事相关，该报约300名工人于10月20日下午6时30分在汉口路274号《新闻报》大楼二楼举行会议。排字工人刘子金 (Liu Tsz-chien) 表示，当地党部决定改组报业工会是由一名前工会成员陆东生 (Loh Tung-sung) 煽动的，此人曾因企图勒索而被开除会籍。他提请会议决定是否接受党部关于改组工会的命令。
经过讨论，通过了以下决议：
1) 接受改组命令，但保留工会原名称，即“报业职工工会”（Newspaper Office Workers' Union）。(根据当地党部的命令，工会名称将改为“报贩业工会”。
2) 非报业职工工会会员不得参与其活动或干涉工会管理。

Subject Alleged "Red" elements among "Sin Wan Pao" workers.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to the attached anonymous letter dated
June 25, 1935, addressed to the Commissioner of Police, alleging
that communist adherents are operating among the workers of the
Sin Wan Pao Newspaper Office, 274 Hankow Road, I have to report
the following :-

On June 20, 1935, Yang Keng Foh (杨根福), a type-setter
in the employ of the Sin Wan Pao, held a dinner party in the
Dah Hung Yung (大鸿运) Restaurant, Woo Bing Road (和丰路), West
Gate, to celebrate his son's birthday. A number of his
fellow-workers attended the invitation. After the feast
the workers proceeded to the offices of the Sin Wan Pao and
participated in a Ping Pong competition held by the printers.
Chu Na Chung (朱乃忠) succeeded in winning a prize which he
requested Wang Ping Chen (汪秉诚) to exhibit in the premises.
Wang refused and attempted to walk away, whereby Chu caught
hold of him and a fight ensued. Tseu Chun Keng (周春耕)
alias Chang Chun Keng (张春耕) then assisted Chu in assaulting
Wang who had struck the first blow. Chu received injuries
to the face. The dispute was brought to the notice of the
Executive Committee of the Sin Wan Pao Newspaper Workers' Union
who decided that Wang should defray all medical expenses
incurred by Chu on the grounds that he had started the fight.

The following day Wang, who had received serious
internal injuries, failed to turn up for work. Chu then
requested two of his fellow-workers named Lieu Tsz Zien (刘智泉)
and Yue Tsing Zung (余清松) to mediate in the altercation
and promised to pay $50 to Wang to enable him to defray his
medical expenses. The proposal was accepted. Wang is
still convalescent and is living at No.3 San Shing Li (三兴里),

1935年6月20日，《新闻报》雇用的排字工人杨根福 (Yang Keng Foh) 在西门和丰路大鸿运餐厅举办晚宴，庆祝其子生日。许多同事应邀出席。宴后，工人们前往《新闻报》馆，参加了印刷工人举行的乒乓球比赛。朱乃忠 (Chu Na Chung) 赢得奖品，并要求汪秉诚 (Wang Ping Chen) 在馆内展示该奖品。汪拒绝并试图走开，朱遂抓住他，引发斗殴。随后周春耕 (Tseu Chun Keng)，又名张春耕 (Chang Chun Keng)，协助朱殴打先动手的汪。朱面部受伤。争端引起《新闻报》报业职工工会执行委员会注意，委员会决定由汪支付朱的所有医疗费用，理由是汪挑起斗殴。

次日，受严重内伤的汪未去上班。朱随后请求两名同事刘智泉 (Lieu Tsz Zien) 和余清松 (Yue Tsing Zung) 调解纠纷，并承诺支付给汪50元以支付其医疗费用。该提议被接受。汪仍在康复中，居住于南市地方法院附近的三兴里3号，

Enquiries at the Public Safety Bureau Headquarters
(3rd Department) show that two workers of the Sin Wan Pao
named Lu Shan Peng (陸善彭) and Liu Fah Sung (劉法森) were arrested on
January 2 by the Chinese Police in the Newspaper Vendors Guild
at See Chang Jao Ka (西昌橋街), City. The Police action
was based on a report that the prisoners had served on the
Committee of the "Red" Newspaper Workers Union of the Sin
Wan Pao branch. The two men confessed that they were
communists, but as they repented their wrong doings and
promised to reform, they were ordered to sign "bonds" and
released on January 7. The other names mentioned in the

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Translation of Anonymous letter.

June 25, 193 5.

To
The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sir,
The Communist employes of the "Sinwanpao",
Nankow Road, have been active: they were put
under arrest whilst holding a meeting in the New-
spaper Workers' Union, Hsiao Tao Yuan Street,
Shanghai City, on the 2nd January, 1935 and were
subsequently allowed to reform. Recently the
principal Communists have resumed their activities
and have directed six or seven followers to
assault Wang Ping Chen, a law-abiding workman, on
a certain pretext on the 20th inst., thereby caus-
ing him injuries to the loin etc. Meantime, his
conditions have become serious and the principal
Communists have instructed their "walking dogs" to
adopt measure to intimidate the family of the
victim not to raise the question. Wang Ping Chen
was assaulted upon, merely for the reason that he
objected to joining the Communist Party. During
the demonstration staged by the Communist Party,
majority of law-abiding workmen dared not xx utter
a word. The "walking dogs" of the Communist Party
made threatening speeches, their object being to
convert all workmen into Communists.

先生：
南京路《新闻报》的共产党雇员一直活动频繁：他们于1935年1月2日在上海市小桃园街报界工会举行会议时被逮捕，随后获准改过自新。近期，主要共产党分子恢复了活动，并指使六七个追随者于本月20日以某种借口袭击了守法工人王炳臣（Wang Ping Chen），导致其腰部等处受伤。目前，他的伤势严重，主要共产党分子已指示其“走狗”采取措施恐吓受害者家属，使其不敢提出此事。王炳臣遭到袭击，仅仅是因为他拒绝加入共产党。在共产党组织的示威活动中，大多数守法工人不敢xx发一言。共产党的“走狗”发表威胁性言论，其目的是将所有工人转化为共产党员。

In these circumstances, I cannot help confidentially reporting the above for your information with the request that inquiries be made by the men under your command for severe disposal so that Communism would not spread among the staff of the "Sinwanpao".

The following are principal Communist employees of the "Sinwanpao" and were arrested on the 2nd January, 1935:-

Lu Shan Peng, Chuan Shan Ch'i, Hsiao Shih Ling, Chu Na Chung, Koo Chin Lung, Wei Chong Yung, Liu Che Ch'uan, Chang Ch'un Keng and Chien Kw'en Sheng etc. They have about several scores of followers.
